    How to read ✕

    Review

    !UnacknowledgedOpen and not reviewed. An active shelf takes it out of this queue. ✓AcknowledgedReviewed. A shelf stays until it expires or is unshelved. ◐Shelved · expires in 3.0 hOut of the queue until the expiry. Shelving does not review it. !Shelf expired · unreviewedBack in the queue: nobody reviewed it.

    Condition

    ●OpenThe newest window still carries the finding. ⊘Open · UnobservableThe newest window could not be judged (excluded or insufficient data), so the condition has not recovered. ○Closed · recoveredAn evaluable, fault-free result with enough qualified support. ○Closed · family changedA different fault family took over the loop. ?Availability unknownRecorded before v2.5.

    Rows

    One rowOne episode of one fault family on one window kind (12h or 24h). A change in its evidence score extends it rather than duplicating it. Triage · NewestWorst first · by the time it opened.

    Fast conditions

    G10 · Valve / saturation, G11 · Sensor healthLimit high, limit low and freeze, detected within a minute, before the next fused window. ◌StaleOpen on record but not updated for 10 min: the engine restarted or the loop's samples stopped.
